effect: Social benefits can no longer be delivered well above what is paid. Delivery could reach 130% of the benefit's value, from doctrine factors or while a backlog drains, while the budget paid 100%. Real delivery is capped at the entitlement; the cap is now 105%, leaving room for the small overshoot the game's doctrine factors give. Under-delivery is unchanged. Expected effect, predicted from the code and checked in the batch run: slightly lower satisfaction where delivery was above 105%, nothing elsewhere. Day 0 unchanged (the ratio starts at 1). No new state.
